name: XLA_TRANSACTION_CONTROL_DETAIL
description: This table stores information about dynamic interface tables created for each event class imported into the Accounting Hub for a specific processing group.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: The short name of the event class associated with the imported transaction.

columns.name: HEADER_INTERFACE_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the interface table that contains the transaction header data for this processing group.

columns.name: LINE_INTERFACE_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the interface table that contains the transaction line data for this processing group.

columns.name: REVERSAL_INTERFACE_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Name of interface table that contains the transaction reversal data for this processing group.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
